mapper.sql: ID, TITLE, Filename, REMARK, fileType, CREATE_DATE, USER_ID, FilePath
mapper.insert: insert into document_inf (id, title, filename, remark, file_type,create_date, user_id, filepath) VALUE (id, #{documentInf.title}, #{documentInf.filename}, #{documentInf.remark}, #{documentInf.fileType}, #{documentInf.createDate}, (select ID from user_inf where Loginname = #{username}), #{documentInf.filePath})
mapper.select:
select d.id, d.title, d.filename, d.remark, d.file_type, d.create_date, u.Loginname as loginName, d.filepath from document_inf d join user_inf u on d.USER_ID = u.ID
and d.TITLE like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and d.Filename like concat('%', #{filename}, '%')
and d.REMARK like concat('%', #{remark}, '%')
and d.CREATE_DATE like concat(#{createDate}, '%')
and d.USER_ID in (select ID from user_inf where Loginname like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%'))
order by d.CREATE_DATE desc
